propositions: Add commit_and_push_tickets_branch entrypoint to acquire write lock, stage and commit dirty tracker changes with optional supplied git identity, then delegate to push_tickets_branch for delivery.
Reject commits when rebase/merge-recovery is in progress: strict mode raises PushDeliveryError with merge-recovery-blocked reason; default mode warns and returns with content retained.

Clean but locally-ahead tracker state is pushed without creating empty commit; persistent rejection under strict mode raises PushDeliveryError and preserves local commit rather than reporting success.

Lock, staging, and commit failures raise dependency-defined PushDeliveryError with stable reasons (commit-lock-timeout, stage-failed, commit-failed); strict mode raises typed errors, default mode warns and returns without invoking push.
Supplied git identity via user.name and user.email config flags is applied per-commit without mutating global or repository configuration; omitted identity uses ambient fallback.
Existing push_tickets_branch remains push-only and does not stage, commit, or alter dirty worktree.
